about: Every user-facing agent-deck operation (ASK-106): what it means, its target, how it is measured. status: measured = a repeatable number exists (Go benchmark here, a budget test, or the Mac lab); live-only = only the opt-in local timings (AGENTDECK_TIMINGS=1, agent-deck perf) or agent-deck health record it; missing = nothing measures it yet. target_by_sessions overrides target_ms per fixture size. exec = the benchmark runs the built binary, so B/op and allocs/op belong to the test process and are not reported.

operations.name: TUI cold start to first frame
operations.means: agent-deck opens to the first frame that shows the session list
operations.how: BenchmarkOp_TUIFirstFrame: NewHome, load N sessions from a real state.db, apply, first View (in process; process start and terminal paint not included). Live: process start to the first populated frame.
operations.note: In-process share only; the live timing adds Go runtime start, config and terminal setup.

operations.name: TUI list render
operations.means: drawing one full frame of the session list
operations.how: BenchmarkOp_TUIListRender: Home.View() at 120x40 with N sessions loaded
operations.note: Debug log has view_render / slow_view_render lines (AGENTDECK_DEBUG).

operations.name: TUI cursor move
operations.means: one arrow key in the list to the next frame
operations.how: BenchmarkOp_TUIKeyNav: Update(KeyDown/KeyUp) + View with N sessions

operations.name: Search / filter
operations.means: filtering the sessions for one typed query
operations.how: BenchmarkOp_TUISearch: session.FilterByQuery over 500 loaded sessions, rotating queries
operations.note: Filter work only; the search overlay frame is not included.

operations.name: Status sweep
operations.means: one status pass over every session (feeds status change -> shown)
operations.how: BenchmarkOp_TUIStatusPass: Home.backgroundStatusUpdate over N live shell sessions on a private tmux socket. Live: tui.status_pass and agent-deck health.
operations.note: Fleet bench baseline: 586 ms at 100, 9 s at 500 mixed sessions (bench/baseline).

operations.name: Status change to shown
operations.means: an agent changes state until the row shows it
operations.how: not measured: poll path is status interval (2 s) + sweep + 2 s tick
operations.note: Worst case on the poll path is about 4 s plus the sweep.

operations.name: Attach
operations.means: Enter on a session to the first byte of the live pane
operations.how: live: first byte copied from the attach PTY (tmux/pty.go firstByteTimer)

operations.name: Detach
operations.means: detach key to the session list drawn again
operations.how: live: detach stamp to the next rendered frame

operations.name: Preview load
operations.means: preview pane fetch for the selected session, after the 150 ms debounce
operations.note: The user also waits the 150 ms debounce.

operations.name: TUI idle CPU
operations.means: CPU used by an idle TUI (target 5% of one core)
operations.how: TestIdleTUICPUBudget (internal/tuitest, budget test); agent-deck health samples CPU% per minute
operations.note: Percent of a core, not ms; budget test only, not in this table.

operations.name: Session store load
operations.means: open state.db and load every session with its groups (every CLI call, TUI start, web request, daemon pass)
operations.note: Target proposed here (ASK-106); agent-deck health has db query latency.

operations.name: CLI cold start
operations.means: agent-deck --version, process start to exit
operations.how: BenchmarkOp_CLIVersion: exec the built binary, sandbox HOME
operations.note: TestPerf_ColdStart_Version gates 40 ms locally.

operations.name: CLI list
operations.means: agent-deck list --json
operations.how: BenchmarkOp_CLIList: exec list --json over N stored sessions (shell/claude/codex) with a file-backed tmux stand-in
operations.note: Results recorded before the stand-in fix (1.16.31, integration-20261019b, 1.16.33-dev) are inflated: the tmux stand-in answered only the first command of the batched pane capture (tmux.PrimePaneCaptures, #2762), so every session paid its own capture-pane fork (about 0.9 ms per session, linear in N). With the fixed stand-in: about 37 ms at 100 and 106 ms at 500 (integration 26cb141e); real tmux with 500 live sessions lists in about 0.2 s with 12 tmux processes. Rerun bench/ops/run.sh to refresh the stored results. The fleet bench numbers (475 ms at 100, 9.7 s at 500) are from 6574d29, before the batched capture.

operations.name: Session add
operations.means: agent-deck add of a session (record only)
operations.how: BenchmarkOp_CLIAdd: exec add -c bash into a profile with 100 sessions

operations.name: Session start
operations.means: agent-deck session start: tmux session created and the tool launching
operations.how: BenchmarkOp_CLISessionStart: exec session start of a shell session on a private tmux socket (stop between runs untimed)
operations.note: Shell session; an agent's time to ready prompt is not included.

operations.name: Send
operations.means: agent-deck session send: message delivered to the session
operations.how: BenchmarkOp_CLISessionSend: exec session send --no-wait to a running shell session
operations.note: --no-wait: the wait for a ready agent is not included.

operations.name: Session stop
operations.means: agent-deck session stop of a running session
operations.how: BenchmarkOp_CLISessionStop: exec session stop (start between runs untimed)

operations.name: Session restart
operations.means: agent-deck session restart to the tool launching

operations.name: Launch
operations.means: agent-deck launch: add, start and the optional first message

operations.name: Session to ready
operations.means: start or restart until the agent shows its prompt
operations.how: not measured (send.WaitForAgentReady polls every 200 ms; no timing kept)
operations.note: Needs a real agent; not reproducible in the sandbox.

operations.name: CLI status
operations.means: agent-deck status

operations.name: Events publish
operations.means: one agent-deck events publish call
operations.note: Bus.Flush waits for the writer's 1 s sync ticker (internal/events/bus.go), so every call takes about 1 s; fix: sync on Flush or Close instead of waiting for the tick.

operations.name: Web menu
operations.means: web UI session menu request served (GET /api/menu)
operations.how: BenchmarkOp_WebMenu: real handler + default SessionDataService, N sessions (shell/claude/codex rows) each with a live shell pane on a private tmux socket
operations.note: Every request reloads state.db and runs a full, unthrottled status pass over all sessions (refreshStatuses, internal/web/session_data_service.go); cost grows faster than N. Claude rows without fresh hook data are forced to a full pane check (ForceNextStatusCheck) on every request.

operations.name: Web UI first paint
operations.means: web UI page load to the session list shown
operations.note: Includes web.menu.

operations.name: Web attach
operations.means: open a session in the web UI to the first terminal bytes
operations.how: not measured (WebSocket ready is sent before the PTY bridge exists)

operations.name: Remote list
operations.means: list the sessions of one ssh remote
operations.how: live: remote fetch; agent-deck health remote_poll_ms

operations.name: Remote attach
operations.means: attach to a session on an ssh remote
operations.how: live: whole visit until the remote client exits
operations.note: Records the whole visit, not time to first byte.

operations.name: Update check
operations.means: release check against GitHub

operations.name: Update install
operations.means: download, verify and install a release

operations.name: Notify daemon pass
operations.means: one notify-daemon pass: reload sessions, refresh tmux, emit transitions
operations.note: Runs every 1 s while any session is running.

operations.name: Notify daemon CPU and memory
operations.means: CPU (target under 5% of a core) and RSS of the always-on notify daemon
operations.how: agent-deck health samples CPU%, RSS, FDs per process role every minute
operations.note: About 33% of a core on an 80-session deck (conductor todo); full state.db load + tmux refresh every 1 s pass, always-on debug logging.

operations.name: Conductor heartbeat time
operations.means: one conductor heartbeat-tick: load fleet, refresh status, build the tick
operations.note: Refreshes every child's status twice (fleet refresh, then UpdateStatus per child).

operations.name: Conductor heartbeat tokens
operations.means: tokens the conductor's model spends per non-empty heartbeat
operations.how: not measured; would come from the conductor transcript costs
operations.note: Empty deltas skip the turn (issue #2348).

operations.name: Timing hook cost (off)
operations.means: cost of one optiming.Start hook when timings are off
operations.note: Proves the hooks are free on hot paths: one atomic load, zero allocations.

operations.name: Timing Since cost (off)
operations.means: cost of one optiming.Since call when timings are off

operations.name: Mac app: switcher open
operations.means: open the session switcher (p95)
operations.note: Latest 112.3 ms p95 (perf2 f178659a1): over budget.

operations.name: Mac app: switcher keystroke
operations.means: one keystroke in the switcher (p95)
operations.note: Latest 80.0 ms p95: over budget.

operations.name: Mac app: switch settle
operations.means: switch session until the view settles (p95)
operations.note: Latest 156.6 ms p95 (d99ce9e9d): within budget.

operations.name: Mac app: main-thread stall
operations.means: longest main-thread block (p95); also MainThreadBudgetTests
operations.note: Latest 64.1 ms p95: over budget.

operations.name: Mac app: streaming worst frame
operations.means: worst frame while output streams (p95)
operations.note: Latest 34.7 ms: just over budget.

operations.name: Mac app: panels settle
operations.means: panel change until layout settles (p95)
operations.note: Latest valid 294.7 ms (integrate 10-19): over budget.

operations.name: Mac app: browser first paint
operations.means: in-app browser first paint (p95)
operations.note: Latest 184 ms: within budget.

operations.name: Mac app: launch first paint
operations.means: app launch to first paint
operations.how: budget defined, never measured in a verdict

operations.name: Mac app: open local session
operations.means: open a local session

operations.name: Mac app: open remote session
operations.means: open a remote session

operations.name: Mac app: typing latency
operations.means: keystroke to echo in the terminal

operations.name: Mac app: idle CPU
operations.means: idle CPU of the Mac app (target 2%)
operations.note: Percent, not ms.
